//: This lives at the SUBMODULE ROOT, not in firebase/, because the Firebase CLI refuses a `public` path outside the directory holding firebase.json — with it in firebase/ the only deployable route was the REST API by hand. Hosting publishes THE GAME ONLY. The repo's docs/ root holds 30+ unrelated projects (realm, harbor-master, the microtools) — pointing hosting at it would publish all of them, which is not what shipping the island means.

hosting.//ignore: tools/ alone is 457 MB of trailer renders and the test harness; loop/ is design docs; release/ is a packaged build; test/ is the node suite. None of it is the game, and Hosting's free tier is 360 MB/day of transfer — shipping them would exhaust it on a couple of visitors.

headers.//: the game is static ES modules with no build step; never serve a stale one
textures and audio are content-addressed by name and change rarely
